description: The avatar window (built at runtime by overlay_windows.rs): its status events, and moving and resizing itself while in Arrange. App commands (avatar_handshake, avatar_beat, set_avatar_mode, avatar_vrm, avatar_loaded, get_settings, power_display, cursor_now, companion_config, companion_report) are not ACL-checked without an app manifest, and must be granted here if one is ever added; companion_config (the brain's token) must be granted to this window alone, and it checks the calling window itself.
